verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs describe customer IDs, MCP tool access, and API keys generally, but nowhere document the ability to mint scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent; in fact, community reports describe an IDOR-style vulnerability where server actions were unauthenticated and any customer_id could be substituted to affect other accounts, indicating the opposite of fine-grained scoping. missing for 10: any documentation of agent-specific API key scopes/roles, credential issuance workflow, or least-privilege enforcement mechanism.
